 November Social Security direct payment worth $994 goes out in six days
 By Adisa Hargett-Robinson 
 Published
 October 24, 2026 9:00am ET
 Advertisement -->
 Advertisement 
 Add Washington Examiner on Google
 Advertisement 
 The November 2026 Supplemental Security Income payments, worth up to $994, will be sent to recipients in six days.
 SSI payments are typically issued on the first day of each month, or on the last business day of the prior month if the first day falls on a federal holiday. Nov. 1 is a Sunday, so recipients will receive their benefits on Oct. 30.
